name: Terrible Life Expectancy
detailed_description:
Death is inherited. In this town your legacy is the only thing that matters. When your Reaper falls, their child, sibling or cousin picks up their gear and continues the fight. But be warned, if your entire bloodline is wiped out, all your hard-earned upgrades are gone forever!
The stakes aren't just one life, are your entire family tree.

Terrible Life Expectancy is a roguelite horror top down shooter where as a family of Teeth Reapers, you fight hordes of mutated humans in the streets of a Japanese town using your weapons arsenal and inherited upgraded gear until the origin of all this death is destroyed forever.

  • Every death counts: As long as there are members from your family tree still alive you'll inherit all your upgraded gear to be used in your next run, but you'll have to start from scratch if your family gets completely anhillilated and choose a new one with different traits.

  • Upgrade wisely: Choose your weapons for your gameplay style and upgrade your gear to improve your stats.

  • Make some bets in your favor (or not) before your run with your hard reaped mutant's teeth. Some sadistic folks like to bet on a Reaper's run, so you can take on the challenges they propose you and collect the rewards or loose a ton of money.

  • Family matters: Choose carefully the family member you want to use in your next run because each one has their advantages and downsides.

  • Street smarts: Know your surroundings! Some houses can always be entered and looted and each area is better or worse for different kinds of warfare and enemies.

  • Don't get too cozy: Different mutants of all sizes and bosses are waiting to meet the fun end of your gun, and altough the town streets won't change, sometimes the conditions of the run get altered by your final enemy: The Arkane Meteorite.
